title: Order Value Supplement on Late Delivery Claims Goodwill
content:
Desk note for Delivery Claims: on a Late Delivery Claim, the late-delivery make-good carries a supplement set by the value of the late order.

**Rule.** The order value supplement depends on the late order's net merchandise (subtotal less discounts): 300.00 USD or more adds 10.00 USD, from 150.00 USD up to but not including 300.00 USD adds 5.00 USD, and less than 150.00 USD adds nothing.

Net merchandise is the merchandise subtotal shown on the order less the discounts shown on it.

| Late order's net merchandise | Supplement |
|---|---|
| 300.00 USD or more | 10.00 USD |
| 150.00 USD up to 299.99 USD | 5.00 USD |
| below 150.00 USD | none |

## Edge cases (hypothetical orders)

| Subtotal | Discounts | Net merchandise | Supplement |
|---|---|---|---|
| 160.00 | 10.01 | 149.99 | none |
| 170.00 | 20.00 | 150.00 | 5.00 USD |
| 320.00 | 20.01 | 299.99 | 5.00 USD |
| 320.00 | 20.00 | 300.00 | 10.00 USD |

The subtotal alone does not decide the band: an order with a subtotal of 320.00 USD and discounts of 30.00 USD has net merchandise of 290.00 USD and adds 5.00 USD.
